claims.paraphrase: Coexpressed 4-OD/VPH and E106Q-VPH complexes were purified; the mutant retained decarboxylase but lacked detected hydratase activity.
The reported 2,4E label concerns a terminal deuterated double bond; it does not identify C2 E/Z. Enol formation and subsequent VPH-associated ketonization are distinct.
Wild-type complex favored a 3S deuterated keto product, while mutant complex gave racemate. The carbon isotope effect supports a proposed late, nearly rate-limiting decarboxylation step.

An official correction exists but its content was not obtained. Detailed mechanistic claims remain correction-sensitive; no numeric isotope effects or exact constructs are accepted from the abstract alone.
